title: [sflow] | sflow doesn't switch to IPv6 agent-id if IPv4 address was removed from interface
author: Hedgehog-Guru
body:
**Description**
sflow doesn't switch to IPv6 agent-id if IPv4 address was removed from the interface

**Steps to reproduce the issue**

1.  Enable sflow, configure some collector to export
2.  Create any new loopback interface by assigning both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses
3.  Use that interface as sflow agent-id

```
    config sflow agent-id add Loopback1
```

4. Remove IPv4 address from that loopback
5. Check exported sflow packets for agent-id

**Describe the results you received**
IPv4 which was removed is still used as agent-id

**Describe the results you expected**
IPv6 is used as agent-id

comments.body: Modification is needed in host-sflow code

I have made PR to sflow repository with potential fix of the issue. The idea of the change is to read IPv6 address and apply it to adaptor, if reading of IPv4 address was unsuccessful. Could somebody check the PR?
https://github.com/sflow/host-sflow/pull/43

I have closed my PR https://github.com/sflow/host-sflow/pull/43, as Sflow team merged to master branch the change, which represents my modifications: https://github.com/sflow/host-sflow/commit/2703ecb173bdbc6b1bc6cdea524eafa9640f141e.
The fix will be accessible for SONiC with the next release of Sflow. In my understanding, SONiC uses concrete release version of Sflow. Could somebody explain what is the procedure to update version of Slow used by the system? It should be updated, when the fix will be released.

linkedPullRequests.title: [sflow] Update version of hsflowd
linkedPullRequests.body:
* Updating version of hsflow daemon to apply
  fix, which resolves problem of switching
  between IPv4 and IPv6, in case when the
  IPv4 has deleted for the interface.

Signed-off-by: Maksym Belei <Maksym_Belei@jabil.com>

<!--
     Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines:
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

     ** Make sure all your commits include a signature generated with `git commit -s` **

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it
Resolves https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6951
The new release of `hsflowd `contains the fix for the issue: https://github.com/sflow/host-sflow/commit/2703ecb173bdbc6b1bc6cdea524eafa9640f141e

#### How I did it
`HSFLOWD_VERSION `env variable has changed in the rules to be pointed to the latest release of `hsflowd`.

#### How to verify it
1. `sudo config sflow enable`
2. `sudo config loopback add Loopback1`
`sudo config int ip add Loopback1 a84f:97ff:fea7:33a5::fe80/64`
`sudo config int ip add Loopback1 192.168.101.1/24`
2. `sudo config sflow agent-id add Loopback1`
`sudo config sflow collector add Collector1 192.168.101.1`
`sudo config sflow collector add Collector2 a84f:97ff:fea7:33a5::fe80`
3. use `sudo sflowtool -p 6343 -l` for checking sflow data
4. remove and add again the ipv4 entry of Loopback1.
`hsflowd `should change agent ip from IPv4 to IPv6 and wise versa, depending on IPv4 entry present or not.
Switching between IPs is being performed by `hsflowd`, based on IP address priority ranking.


#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

<!--
- Note we only backport fixes to a release branch, *not* features!
- Please also provide a reason for the backporting below.
- e.g.
- [x] 202006
-->

- [ ] 201811
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202006
- [x] 202012

The issue has reported on 202012, but is reproducible on master branch too.

#### Description for the changelog
<!--
Write a short (one line) summary that describes the changes in this
pull request for inclusion in the changelog:
-->
Update of hsflowd to the latest release version.
